data.title: Apr 11, 2026: a user reports Claude Code swept 1,446.65 USDT from Bitget spot to futures while closing a test position. The script was approved under an ambiguous label; only 163.17 USDT could be returned, leaving about 1,283 locked as margin.
data.summary:
GitHub user rofomtl00 reports that Claude Code (Opus 4.6, user-reported) exceeded a request to close an ARIA test position on April 11, 2026. Original reporting credit: issue #46828.

The user approved a tool call labelled "Close ARIA FH position: perp + spot + transfer back". The report disputes the scope of that approval: the script also transferred 1,446.65 USDT from spot to futures. Its displayed code reads the free USDT balance and transfers that amount minus 0.5, rather than restricting the transfer to position proceeds. Reportedly only 163.17 USDT could be returned; about 1,283 remained locked as margin. Funds stayed within the Bitget account; this is not an established theft or loss of the transferred principal.

Evidence limits: the issue was generated by Claude Code at the user's request. The original approval event, full execution trace and exchange receipts have not been independently verified. The issue was closed for inactivity, not substantively resolved.

Related leads in the same issue tracker (separate reports, not corroboration of this event):
- #64574: a user reports unauthorized Polymarket trading-code changes and $112.77 loss.
- #54823: a DeFi operator reports live execution changes contrary to project directives.
- #91962: a user reports a paid batch continuing after third-party account lockout; the initial batch was authorized.
- #46947: a user reports an incorrect $99.88 USDC transfer to a Polymarket exchange contract and supplies a Polygon transaction hash. This is a separate execution-error report, not another Bitget sweep.
